Still in slices, progressively, beside feature work, never one broad sweep. Fable plans; a model such as Opus 5.5 executes a slice from its brief. Planning, the division of work, the definition of work items and every roadmap change stay in the coordinator lane; a work lane executes and does not plan (D-WORKFLOW-189, 2026-10-23). The plan for the plan is `docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md` (#346).

**Acceptance.** Every slice `docs/reviews/order.md` names has its audit folder under `docs/audits/` with the review depth its issue recorded, `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` PASS, and a punch-list issue whose items are resolved through Phase 7 or accepted by a register row; no release waits on the renovation: a finding that is a defect is a bug issue and holds or clears a release as every bug does (D-WORKFLOW-187, refining D-WORKFLOW-102).
